title: Independent homepage browser evidence
content:
## Scoped verdict: pass

Root: `/home/webe/workspace/copilot-worktrees/webe-opolis/justin-leis-urban-giggle`  
Case: `WO-2a6bafff-7f89-47e2-b497-d5dc4519dd84`  
Revision: staged `docs/index.html`, SHA-256 `089760a5ff6e7276537547d2996a7bb39ceaf670bb79f3c9a0c9575b1d5b0b9b`

| Check | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Tab / Shift-Tab | **Pass** | Firefox keyboard actions moved focus first link → second → first. |
| Enter | **Pass** | Both links produced trusted click events with the expected URLs. Default navigation was prevented. |
| Visible focus | **Pass** | Both narrow screenshots show the focus outline; rendered samples measured 14.30–14.41:1 against adjacent pixels. |
| Narrow / wide rendering | **Pass** | Inspected screenshots at 375×812 and 1440×900; content and links remained readable. |
| Text contrast | **Pass, sampled** | Representative rendered backgrounds measured 6.47–17.05:1 against their text colors. This is not an exhaustive contrast audit. |

**Commands and results:** `sha256sum docs/index.html` and `git --no-pager show :docs/index.html | sha256sum` both returned the requested digest. The Firefox 160.0.1 BiDi run used Node keyboard `input.performActions`; it exited 0 after the browser was terminated and its temporary profile removed. Its exact inline command is in tool session **1863**. Screenshot pixels were decoded with `ffmpeg` in sessions **1866** and **1868**; both exited 0. Kernel filtering denied browser outbound connections.

Screenshots: `/tmp/city-browser-evidence-dTYQSy/`. They are temporary, not filed records. Live navigation, publication, and full delivery compliance were not tested.

**Persistence pending:** please forward this report unchanged through City Manager to the Records Officer. No lifecycle or record changes were made. Inspection verdict not recorded; acceptance remains the resident’s decision.
